name: @credninja/example-x64dbg-delegation-proxy
description: Worked example: a scoped, delegated, audited reverse proxy in front of the unauthenticated x64dbg-mcp-server. Demonstrates draft-sweeney-wimse-credential-delegation.
comment: Run with `npx tsx <file>`. This directory is NOT an npm workspace member; do not run `npm install` here (it would reach the monorepo root). tsx and the @credninja/* source resolve via ../../packages and tsconfig paths. devDependencies below are only for copying this example OUT of the monorepo to run standalone.
